from click.types import convert_type, Choice, FuncParamType, STRING, INT
for factory in (set, frozenset):
    result = convert_type(factory(['z', 'a']))
    assert isinstance(result, Choice) and result.choices == ['a', 'z']
    assert result.convert('a', None, None) == 'a'
    for value in (factory(), factory([1]), factory(['a', 1])):
        assert isinstance(convert_type(value), FuncParamType)
    assert convert_type(None, factory(['a'])) is STRING
assert convert_type(str) is STRING
assert convert_type(int) is INT
